{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|Let this power enter you and fill you with the ''knowledge'' and the ''strength'' of the dark side of the Force that is ''mine'' to give&mdash;!|[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] empowering his [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]]|<ref name="Dark Empire II 4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref>}}
Some [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] were able to '''enhance''' the [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] of those with weaker connections to [[the Force/Legends|the Force]]. A reborn [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] performed [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] rituals to empower his [[Dark Side Elite]], occurrences which created a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance]] that could be felt around the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

==Behind the scenes==
It is unknown how this ritual fits in the fact of [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] as this use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] was first created in [[1991]], eight years before midi-chlorians were introduced in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']]. However, as explained in the writings Darth Sidious obtained from his [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|master]], it would be possible to increase the midi-chlorian count of living beings via the application of the Force.<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> Further evidence of this is during Chapter 24 of the [[novel]] [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|Darth Plagueis]], the book refers to Plagueis having an increased midi-chlorian count while in a section surrounding Plagueis's [[Midi-chlorian manipulation|manipulation of the midi-chlorians]]. Implying that Plagueis had found a way to increase his own midi-chlorian count, but considering the context of the scene he presumably performed the technique through midi-chlorian manipulation.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
